# sigma_workspace_grant (Resource)

Grants a workspace permission to a member or team. Composite ID `<workspace_id>:<grant_id>`. Permission enum: `view`, `explore`, `organize`, `edit`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Grant a team `view` on a workspace. Members of the team see every workbook
# inside the workspace at this permission level (or higher, if a per-workbook
# grant exists). Permission options: view, explore, edit, account.
resource "sigma_workspace_grant" "analytics_engineering" {
  workspace_id = sigma_workspace.analytics.id
  team_id      = sigma_team.engineering.id
  permission   = "view"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permission` (String) One of `view`, `explore`, `organize`, `edit`. These map to the Sigma Share-dialog labels: `view`=Can view, `explore`=Can explore, `organize`=**Can contribute**, `edit`=**Can manage**. Note the last two are easy to get backwards — `organize` is the mid-tier "Can contribute", `edit` is the top-tier "Can manage".
- `workspace_id` (String)

### Optional

- `member_id` (String) Exactly one of `member_id` or `team_id` must be set.
- `team_id` (String) Exactly one of `member_id` or `team_id` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `grant_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_workspace_grant.example '<workspace_id>:<grant_id>'
```
